input: Source a vintage typewriter for the home study

gold.taskTitle: Source a Vintage Typewriter for the Home Study
gold.taskDescription: Find and acquire a vintage typewriter suitable for use or display in a home study.

questions.title: Is this typewriter for display, actual typing, or both?
questions.description: Understand the primary purpose so sourcing criteria can be matched accordingly.

questions.title: Do you have a specific era or brand in mind?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants a particular period such as 1920s, 1950s, or a brand like Underwood, Olivetti, or Hermes.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for this purchase?
questions.description: Establish a clear spending limit to filter sourcing options appropriately.

questions.title: Do you want it fully restored or acceptable as-found?
questions.description: Determine whether condition and mechanical functionality are priorities or if cosmetic patina is acceptable.

questions.title: Are you open to buying online, or local sources only?
questions.description: Clarify geographic and channel preferences such as antique shops, markets, eBay, or Etsy.

questions.title: Is there a specific colour or aesthetic you need it to match?
questions.description: Understand any visual or interior design constraints tied to the home study decor.

questions.title: How soon do you need the typewriter acquired?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or urgency level to prioritise fast versus thorough sourcing strategies.
